title: Ana Sayfa
purpose: Primary home tab root. Renders greeting, 23:59 countdown CTA (AC-FR-E2-01-01), subscription badge (AC-FR-E2-02-01), content area nav cards (AC-FR-E2-03-01), program summary card (AC-FR-E2-04-01), active content section (max 3, AC-FR-E2-06-01), recent activity list, and daily reminder nudge (AC-FR-E2-08-01).

loading.description: Skeleton cards shown for header, stats row, continue card, and content nav section. PActivityIndicator at top. Critical cards (Bugun ozeti, Devam Et) shown first.

ready.description: Full dashboard: greeting + subscription badge, search bar (taps open HomeSearch), stats row (streak/completed/badges), Devam Et card with 23:59 countdown timer, content area nav grid (Yolculuklar/Atolyeler/e-Kitaplar/Kocluk Okulu), program summary card, active content list (max 3), recent activities, reminder nudge if not yet set.

empty.description: No active content: show compass illustration with 'Ilk yolculugunu sec' headline and 'Kesfe Cik' CTA navigating to Discover tab. Stats still visible with zero values.

error.description: Card-level retry: each section that fails shows inline 'Tekrar Dene' button (AC-FR-E2-09-03). Header always visible.

offline.description: OfflineBanner at top. Last cached data shown. Devam Et CTA enabled for cached content. Write-actions (Hatirlaticiya Ekle, Kaydet) disabled and dimmed.
